title: Fix RPL DIO admission comments: unicast DIOs rejected at codec gate, not wire_is_for_local
description: Codereview finding (pass 1, correctness) from worker6-8rm3 verification round. Comment at rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs:623 (mirrored at rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/transmit.rs:99) claims 'a unicast-destination DIO would be inadmissible at wire_is_for_local before admission even runs'. Traced pipeline: wire_is_for_local (util.rs:152-170) admits L2-unicast-to-me frames unconditionally (util.rs:158) and admits broadcast-L2 unicast-dst RPL packets; dio_dis_destination_is_allowed (util.rs:200-216) explicitly permits dst = local link-local. The REAL rejection point for a unicast-dst DIO is the codec gate inside process_authenticated_dio (router.rs:413-421 -> lichen-schc codec.rs:2226/2249 authenticated_dio_destination_is_canonical_multicast), which also fires revoke_schc_peer. Stated conclusion (unicast DIOs rejected, leaf joins via multicast) is correct; only the cited enforcement filter is wrong. Risk: future maintainer weakens dio_dis_destination_is_allowed believing wire_is_for_local is the guard. Fix: rewrite both comments to cite the codec admission gate (and note the revoke side effect). Discovered-from: project-LICHEN-worker6-8rm3
close_reason: Fixed both comments (receive.rs:619-630, transmit.rs:96-106): unicast-destination DIO rejection now correctly attributed to the canonical-multicast gate inside process_authenticated_dio (lichen-schc codec.rs:2226/2249, revoke_schc_peer at router.rs:420) instead of the wrong wire_is_for_local claim. Delegated verification pass (kimi-k3) confirmed the full pipeline order (wire_is_for_local and dio_dis_destination_is_allowed do NOT reject unicast-to-local DIOs; the schc gate is the first and actual rejection point) and that the old comments were wrong. Comment-only diff, no behavioral surface: passes 2-3 skipped with that justification (same pattern as worker6-ehcn close). rpl_stack suite 63/63 green.
